UPI RALLY RELOCATED

LOOK: The United People's Initiative, a group of protesters led by retired military officials, move their rally to a shopping mall along EDSA-Ortigas Avenue in Quezon City on Tuesday, Nov. 18.

The UPI said the Quezon City government denied its permit application to continue its rally at the People Power Monument. The group's three-day rally was supposed to end on Tuesday.

📸 Niño Manalo/NewsWatch Plus

She is Shaila. 15 years old a sex worker. Due to her stepmother's torture, she runs away from her house and tries to go to her aunt's in Dhaka, Bangladesh. "Somehow I managed to get a seat on a ,bus which was going to Dhaka. There was too much traffic so my bus was stuck in one place for hours. It was getting darker and I did not know what to do. When I got off the bus, it was midnight,12 am. I was so afraid that I asked every single female passenger to give me a shelter for one night. I was crying and did not know what to do. No one believed me. If on that day someone would had given me a shelter for just one night, my life would not have fallen into hell" she said. During the journey he is kidnapped by a group and she found herself in a brothel.

Child prostitution is the sexual exploitation and abuse of the vulnerability and / or trust of a child for sexual purposes. This can be in exchange for money , clothes, food or any other promise. It can happen at home, in brothels, bars, massage parlours, but also remotely via the Internet.

Research suggests that there may be as many as 10 million children involved in prostitution worldwide. The practice is most widespread in South America and Asia, but prostitution of children exists globally, in undeveloped countries as well as developed. Millions of girls and boys worldwide are victims of sexual exploitation. According to NGOs, the countries with the highest child prostitution rates are Brazil, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Taiwan, the Philippines and the USA.

Editorial Photo by GMB Akash @GmbAkash
